explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result. The theorem says that each adjoint root subgroup element lies in the adjoint elementary group. Both objects are the library's own definitions, built from its Kostant/Chevalley-system construction. The proof unfolds them and applies another lemma of the library, `UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.kostantRootSubgroupParam_mem_kostantElementarySubgroup`. A case-insensitive grep of the Mathlib source for "kostant", "ChevalleySystem" and "ElementarySubgroup" returned no files. So Mathlib does not have these notions, and nothing there can carry this content.
